title: Uniformly Roasted Irish Lamb Casserole
description: A dense and flavorful Irish dish featuring lamb, galangal, and kha, roasted to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, perfect for meal prep and low sodium diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the lamb cubes with olive oil, salt-free seasoning, galangal, kha, garlic, and onions until they are evenly coated.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the bowl and toss until they are well combined with the lamb mixture.
Transfer the lamb and vegetable mixture to a ttukbaegi earthenware pot or a large Dutch oven with a tight-fitting lid.
Cover the pot with a lid and roast the casserole in the preheated oven for 2.5 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze the leftover casserole for later meal prep.
